title: Transnasal gastroscopy (thin scope)
what: This is an exam of the esophagus, stomach, and start of the bowel with a thin tube with a camera, passed through the nose instead of the mouth.
why: For belly pain, heartburn, or trouble swallowing; and for people who find regular gastroscopy hard because of the gag reflex.
duration: usually 10 to 20 minutes; the report is handed over right away, and a biopsy result takes 1 to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: Frequent nosebleeds, a deviated septum, or nose surgery
Diabetes, since fasting time and medicines must be adjusted

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food for 6 to 8 hours. Water until the time the clinic says.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor which medicines to take in the morning.

prepare.title: Nose
prepare.text: If your nose is blocked, tell your doctor beforehand.

steps: The doctor asks which nostril is easier for you to breathe through
A numbing and decongestant spray goes into your nose
You sit or lie on your left side
The thin tube is passed through your nose and you are asked to swallow
The doctor examines the esophagus, stomach, and start of the bowel, and takes a tissue sample if needed
feel: Pressure and tickling in the nose when it goes in
The gag reflex is usually much weaker than with regular gastroscopy
You can talk during the procedure
The belly feels a little full from air
after: Until the throat numbness is gone, usually about an hour, do not eat or drink
Nose numbness and slight bloating go away on their own
Without sedation, you can go home and drive right away
If a biopsy was taken, the result comes in 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: A heavy nosebleed that does not stop in 15 minutes
Vomiting blood or black stools: call emergency services
Severe belly or chest pain, or a fever

faq.q: Is it easier than regular gastroscopy?
faq.a: For many people yes: the tube is thinner and does not press on the back of the tongue, so there is less gagging.

faq.q: Is the nose route right for everyone?
faq.a: Not for everyone. With narrow nasal passages, or if treatment is needed, the doctor may choose the regular way.

reminders.text: Gastroscopy through the nose tomorrow. Do not eat after dinner, and drink water only until the time the clinic gave.
